summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for Admin Panel enhancements: moving Student Groups and Fee Concessions under the Finance section, converting Basic Info Logo to client-side compressed Base64 image upload (<=60KB), defaulting Notifications date to current date with manual editing support, upgrading Gallery to dedicated compressed photo upload (<=50KB) with auto-incrementing order numbers starting at 50 and full edit capability, implementing robust mobile dual-camera switching (front/back) across Add Student, Manage Student, and Student Portal, and relocating Staff photo upload to the top of the form with mobile camera support.
